programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2507
programme.desc: Rikke från Køge är 44 år gammal och ekonomiskt beroende av sin äldsta dotter och ex-make. Hon bor nu på obestämd tid i soffan i vardagsrummet hos sin äldsta dotters far tillsammans med sin dotter.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark
programme.desc: Matthias och Carma har stora framtidsdrömmar, men Matthias förflutna står i vägen. Trots att han bara är 23 år gammal har han en historia av euforiserande droger, hot från gäng och hjärtattacker.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2806
programme.desc: I Nykøbing F möter vi Daniel, som är far till två barn, men som inte betalar underhållsbidrag och har skulder på konsumtionslån och obetalda räkningar. Daniel gör ingenting för att förändra situationen.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2505
programme.desc: Karina från Tommerup på Fyn lever som om hon har mycket pengar och köper designerkläder - men i själva verket kämpar hon för att upprätthålla sin fasad för att dölja sina ekonomiska problem.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 3005
programme.desc: I ett tidigare förhållande fick Michael skulder på omkring 800 000 danska kronor, och även om han har försökt få ordning på sin ekonomi försvinner pengarna från hans konto innan månaden är slut.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 3001
programme.desc: Patrick bor i Hvidovre. Under de senaste åren har Patrick isolerat sig mer och mer i sin lägenhet eftersom han skäms över sina stora skulder och över att ha förlorat sitt körkort för att han kört för fort.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: Austin spends the night on the north slope after going into the ditch; Darrell gets up early to keep his lead; Alex races south to get another load; Hugh and Rick take on a load of two massive cement trucks.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: A polar bear standoff at Prudhoe Bay ties up Carlile's loads at the most crucial time of the season; a veteran trucker's calculated risk puts his life and livelihood in jeopardy; one rookie's sent packing as the other picks up the slack.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: Hugh and Rick come across an obstacle that could help Alex take the lead; Maya is dispatched in a convoy with Lisa for her first trip to the village of Nuiqsut; Tony deals with melting ice on the road; Dave boards an airplane destined for Alabama.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: Alex heads farther north than ever before on the deadly Dempster; Hugh and Rick face an impossible task on the thin ice of Manitoba's winter roads; Jack Jessee returns to lead a pack of hungry new drivers.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: Alex drives on the Arctic Ocean; Hugh and Rick search for missing trailers; Jack tries to mentor a young driver.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: Alex tries to deliver a load to a village across an icy river delta, Hugh and Rick fight the melting winter roads to deliver their load to Winnipeg.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Wild West
programme.desc: Allen and Ton explain their strategies at a storage auction in San Bernardino, win two units, then have a Pepperbox gun and vintage Lionel train set appraised by experts.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Hot Commodity
programme.desc: Allen is late to the auction, leaving Ton to battle a feisty female auction buyer on his own! The guys find a fully functional flamethrower and a rare hand-carved bow and arrow set from South America!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Strat'ed for Cash
programme.desc: On a limited budget in the historic L.A. neighborhood of West Adams, Allen and Ton still win three lockers and find a Maui Blue Fender Stratocaster and a 1930s Schwinn bike.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Viva la Vegas
programme.desc: 1974 death-defying Zig Zag magic sword box, an ultra-rare 1910 poster of the infamous magician Chung Ling Soo, an 1800s naval cane sword and century-old Metlach German beer steins.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Labor of Love
programme.desc: Harley Davidson V-twin EVO engine and revolutionary 1958 dual-suspension swingarm frame; '80s Ms. Pac-Man arcade machine; rare Air Jordan vintage shoe collection in mint condition.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Miami Heat
programme.desc: All-terrain Air Commander Hovercraft, a 1970s NASA countdown clock and a one-of-a-kind 1960s Delta Relay rocket.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ice, Ice, Baby
programme.desc: Ton and Allen have to get aggressive when they encounter a towering opponent with a mountain of cash. The guys uncover a vintage ice resurfacing machine and an Olympic biathlon rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Voodoo Moola
programme.desc: Allen & Ton hit a storage auction in Louisiana's Capitol City and quickly find themselves in trouble with the law! The guys uncover a pair of racing lawnmowers and then stumble on an antique barber chair from the early 1900s!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Got Balls
programme.desc: After returning to LA, Ton & Allen head deep into hostile auction hunter territory and butt heads with a familiar old foe! They discover a driving range golf ball picker vehicle and one of the most accurate rifles ever made!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Big Score
programme.desc: At a climate-controlled storage facility in downtown L.A., Allen and Ton's locker wins score them an antique cash register and a German H&K pistol prized by collectors.

programme.title: Captain Fantastic
programme.desc: Viggo Mortensen medverkar i denna gripande och roliga berättelse om en pappa med en annorlunda inställning till föräldraskapet som blir tvungen att visa den moderna världen för barnen.

programme.title: Worth
programme.desc: Efter terrorattackerna den 11 september utser kongressen advokaten Kenneth Feinberg till att leda kompensationsfonden för offren. Feinberg står nu inför en omöjlig uppgift - att avgöra vad ett liv är värt.

programme.title: Judy
programme.desc: 1968 anländer Judy Garland till London för en rad utsålda konserter. Utåt charmar Judy alla med sin värme och karisma, men inuti är hon djupt ärrad av ett liv i rampljuset och en tuff vårdnadstvist.

programme.title: A Christmas Blessing
programme.desc: Mandy säljer sin avlidna fasters välgörenhetsorganisation. Men Otto, som brukade arbeta som volontär där, vill anordna en sista välgörenhetsjulmiddag.

programme.title: Christmas is You
programme.desc: En kontorsassistent ställs inför ett dilemma när hennes chef säger åt henne att hon ska övertala sin före detta pojkvän att skriva kontrakt med deras skivbolag, eller leta efter ett nytt jobb.

programme.title: The Christmas Spirit
programme.desc: Charlotte hamnar i koma efter en olycka, men hennes själ är vaken. Inför en omröstning om ett fastighetsprojekt måste hon få sin stad och byggherren att ändra sig, samtidigt som ingen kan se eller höra henne.

programme.title: Christmas Party Crashers
programme.desc: När två bedragare möts efter att ha kraschat samma miljonärs julfest går de med på att arbeta tillsammans, utan att veta att de kommer att hitta något som är viktigare än pengar eller berömmelse: sann kärlek.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation
programme.desc: Första kvällen i Las Vegas spårar JWoww ur, och köttbullarna förbereder sig för apokalypsen. Hemma i Jersey rensar Angelina och 2.0 luften.

programme.desc: Michelle Trachtenberg learns that size does matter. Things turn desperate for Nicollette Sheridan when she tries to help someone pop the question. Travis Pastrana gets taken for a ride when he is confronted by an angry husband in his hotel room.

programme.title: MTV Cribs SV: Don and Liane V Benjamin / Bleu / Charo
programme.desc: Don och Liane V Benjamin visar upp sitt hem i L.A., Bleu visar upp sin eleganta herrgård i Georgia och Charo ger oss en rundtur i sin spanskinspirerade villa.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Chanel and Sterling CLXXXIX
programme.desc: I ett nytt avsnitt av Ridiculousness står Rob, Chanel och Steelo inte ut med whistle blowers in I HATE MY COACH, analyserar senaste festmodet i 'Kepsen vänd, bringan bränd' och tröttnar i 'Inte kul på hjul'.

programme.title: Teen Mom OG: Flying By the Seat of Our Pants
programme.desc: Amber vill återuppta kontakten med Leah och skickar ett känslosamt videomeddelande. Maci och Taylor är rädda att Maverick kan hindras från att gå i förskola. Catelynn och Tyler semestrar i Florida och träffar Mackenzie och Josh.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Chanel and Sterling CXXX
programme.desc: I detta nya avsnitt av 'Ridiculousness' ser Rob, Steelo och Chanel när några blir 'Doktorer direkt' och ser om de kan klara lite 'Vind-softning'.

programme.desc: Några av nykomlingarna blir irriterade på Nats konstanta daddande. Nathan slår sig ihop med de andra singlarna Tahlia och Alex. Sam och Chloe har det mycket bättre och efter en jobbig dag blir Beau sams med Bethan.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation
programme.desc: Jersey-familjen träffas i MTV:s studio på Time Square för att snacka köttbullar och säsongens stora bråk. Är det okej mellan Angelina och Mike? Kan en ny bästis komma emellan Jenni och Nicole? Det får ni se i 'Jersey Shore: Family Vacation Reunion'.

programme.title: The History of Love
programme.desc: Det var en gång en pojke som hette Leo som älskade en flicka som hette Alma. Leo lovade Alma att han skulle få henne att skratta hela livet. Men så kom kriget och skilde dem åt.

programme.title: About Us
programme.desc: Ett par vill väcka liv i kärleken och åker tillbaka till platsen där de tillbringade sin smekmånad åtta år tidigare. De kämpar tillsammans för att nå varandra igen. Allt kulminerar i en hjärtskärande final när dolda sanningar kommer upp i ljuset.

programme.title: Life Itself
programme.desc: Oscar Isaac, Olivia Cooke och Antonio Banderas är bara några av stjärnorna i dramat Life Itself. Där samma händelse kommer påverka många människors liv. Vi får följa dem över årtionden, från gatorna i New York till den spanska landsbygden.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 515
programme.desc: Det är serveringsdag på Camp Kulinaris. Efter en varierad menysmakning igår har deltagarna mycket att bevisa. Kan restaurangchefen vända skeppet?

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 516
programme.desc: Det är tävlingsdag på Camp Kulinaris och Linda står inför ett svårt val. Deltagarnas smaklökar sätts på prov och Bahareh är missnöjd med kaffeproduktionen.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 517
programme.desc: Det är framdukat för en annorlunda vecka på Camp Kulinaris. Deltagarna kastas in i en stor utmaning, som skapar både glädje och frustration i köket.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 518
programme.desc: Trioveckan fortsätter på Camp Kulinaris. De tre lagen får äntligen veta vad de ska servera imorgon och stämningen försämras i köket.

programme.desc: Det är serveringsdag på Camp Kulinaris. De tre lagen ska laga japanska rätter inför gästerna och det blå laget kämpar med samarbetet.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 520
programme.desc: Det är tävlingsdag på Camp Kulinaris. De två förlorande lagen från gårdagens servering får testa sitt samarbete i en kaotisk lärlingsmatch.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 406

programme.desc: Det är killkväll i soffan. MVP och Ronnie pratar om Mike och Paulas uppbrott, om att hitta tjejer i Seaside och varför hela grabbligan är så jävlig mot Jionni.

programme.desc: Den allra sista gången i soffan försöker Mike och Nicole att begrava stridsyxan. Vinny och Jionni blir sams, och Deena accepterar att även köttbullar kan växa upp.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Jersey Shore Best of Reunions
programme.desc: Amy Paffrath visar oss alla höjdpunkter och lågvattenmärken från tidigare återföreningar - och även material som aldrig visats tidigare.,

programme.title: Jersey Shore: The Tanned Triangle
programme.desc: Snooki känner sig fortfarande utanför och vill lämna huset. Kamraternas första utekväll blir såpass vild att pojkvännerna hemmavid bör oroa sig.

programme.title: America's Next Top Model: Make Me Tall
programme.desc: The ladies meet with Miss J to perfect their runway strut for designer Kevan Hall's fashion show. They learn to cheat their own proportions in the next fashion shoot.

programme.title: America's Next Top Model: Take My Photo, Tyra!
programme.desc: The girls must work extra hard to stand out, literally, when Tyra wraps them up in vibrant fabrics and photographs them during this week's photo challenge. This week's guest judge is supermodel China Chow, a famous petite model.

programme.title: America's Next Top Model: Dance With Me
programme.desc: The girls go on a surprise trip to Vegas for the Cirque du Soleil-themed photo shoot. Benny Ninja teaches the nine remaining models how to dance without expressions on their faces.

programme.title: America's Next Top Model: Petite Ninja Warriors
programme.desc: The girls must navigate themselves around Los Angeles for an afternoon of go-sees. This week's photoshoot has a martial arts-inspired theme that has the girls hanging, literally, by a wire.

programme.title: America's Next Top Model: Interview 101
programme.desc: The girls put their interviewing skills to the test as they interview 90210's Jessica Lowndes on the set of The Insider. The ladies are surprised to learn they must write their own scripts for their CoverGirl commercials.

programme.title: America's Next Top Model: Dive Deeper
programme.desc: The ladies explore the cliffs of Hawaii and are forced to strike a modelesque pose while jumping into the water. Later the girls learn to pose while deep in the Pacific Ocean.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 8
programme.desc: Fler ska sållas bort och det är bara två lektioner kvar, men tjejerna kämpar för att få på sig sina berömda vita cowboystövlar för första gången. Sen ska Judy och Megan Fox ge kritik vid sista dansen.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 1
programme.desc: Det är nervöst och spänt när 600 Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders-aspiranter anländer till hotellet för uttagningarna. Varje tävlande har två minuter att dansa för domarna.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 2
programme.desc: I slututtagningen blir det kraftig konkurrens och endast de starka överlever. DCC-aspiranter måste nu tävla mot cheerleaderveteraner för att få en plats på träningslägret.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 3
programme.desc: Om kandidaterna trodde att uttagningarna var tuffa så har de ingen aning om hur brutalt träningslägret kommer att vara. Första veckan på Valley Ranch inleds med att tjejerna får veta vad för poäng de fick av domarna.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 4
programme.desc: Det är bara tredje veckan på träningslägret, men det är redan dags att börja skicka hem folk. Vem kommer att överleva? Veckan börjar med uniformsprovning där även aspiranterna får prova den berömda blå och vita, stjärnbeströdda uniformen.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 5
programme.desc: Dags att ta fram tjejernas DCC-look. Rakt eller lockigt hår? Blond eller rödhårig? Tjejerna vet ingenting om vad Kelli och frisören Rainer Schneck har planerat för dem när de får sin dramatiska DCC-makeover.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 202

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 204

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Värmland
programme.desc: Värmland is home to many of Sweden’s most famous authors and inventors. However, it is also a place with a rich food culture. Tareq gets his hands on a very rare bird to cook and also takes time out to float down a tranquil river on a wooden raft.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Fyn
programme.desc: Tareq visits Fyn, the fairy tale capital of the world. Famous as the birthplace of Hans Christian Andersen, Fyn is also known as the garden of Denmark. Here we explore stunning nature and world class cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höga Kusten
programme.desc: Created thousands of years ago, the High Coast in the northern part of Sweden is the highest coast in the world. Tareq sets out to sample one of the most extreme types of Swedish food, fermented herring.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Denmark
programme.desc: North Jutland has a rich culinary history. The unique conditions have created equally unique products. Tareq meets local food entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever changing environment and putting this region on the culinary map.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Uppsala
programme.desc: Uppsala is the city of knowledge: home to the oldest university in Scandinavia. It’s a wonderful agricultural area surrounded by fertile flatlands. Tareq discovers the historical treasures of Uppsala and its thriving culinary life.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Sealand
programme.desc: North Zealand has been a playground of the rich and famous since the fifteenth century. Tareq learns how this beautiful north eastern part of Denmark is the perfect place to go foraging for wild berries and herbs.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Family Friction!

programme.title: Geordie Shore: It's Fright Night!

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Hello New Lad!

programme.title: The Hound Of The Baskervilles (1959)

programme.title: The Sum of All Fears
programme.desc: East-West tensions erupt when the CIA suspects that renegade Russian scientists are developing more nuclear weapons.

programme.title: Jack Ryan: Shadow Recruit

programme.title: 13 Hours: The Secret Soldiers of Benghazi
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay, 13 HOURS is the gripping true story of six elite ex-military operators assigned to protect the CIA who fought back against overwhelming odds when terrorists attacked a U.S. diplomatic compound on September 11, 2012.

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part II
programme.desc: Five years after the bloodbath at Camp Crystal, all that remains is the legend of Jason and his demented mother, who had murdered seven camp counselors. At a nearby summer camp, the new counselors are unconcerned about the warnings to stay away.

programme.title: Friday the 13th - Part III
programme.desc: Ignoring Camp Crystal Lake’s bloody legacy, one by one they fall victim to the maniacal Jason who stalks them at every turn...

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part - IV: The Final Chapter
programme.desc: After his revival in a hospital morgue, the hockey-masked murderer fixes his vengeful attention on the Jarvis family and a group of hitherto carefree teenagers.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Madea's Big Happy Family
programme.desc: When Shirley receives distressing news about her health, it’s up to her Aunt Madea to gather the clan and make things right the only way she knows how: with tough love and laughter.

programme.title: Head of State
programme.desc: When Washington desperately needs a presidential candidate just weeks before the election, they need someone sure to lose. They pick Mays Gilliam (Chris Rock), an unknown local politician from a down-and-out D.C. neighborhood, to be their puppet.

programme.title: Good Burger
programme.desc: Kenan & Kel are serving up laughs! They're the good guys in Good Burger, a zany comedy inspired by the popular Kel routine from Nickelodeon's hit series All That.

programme.title: Swordsman II [English Subtitled]
programme.desc: Ling Wu Chung decides to hide from the chaotic world. Before leaving, he visits his friends, a tribe of snake-wielding women warriors. However, he finds that the tribe have been attacked, and their leader Yam Ying Ying has been abducted.

programme.title: The Legend [English Subtitled]
programme.desc: This Hong Kong martial-arts extravaganza tells of evil emperors and true love. The secret Red Lotus Flower Society is committed to the overthrow of the evil Manchu Emperor and his minions.

programme.title: The Legend 2 [English Subtitled]
programme.desc: The Cantonese hero Fong Sai Yuk becomes involved in the secret brotherhood "The Red Flower", who are trying to overthrow the Manchurian emperor and re-establishing the Ming dynasty.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Four teens are tricked by their professor into visiting a haunted house for a school project.

programme.title: Scary Movie 3
programme.desc: David Zucker (AIRPLANE!) directs SCARY MOVIE 3, which piles on hysterical yet gratuitous cameos from thrillers, blockbusters, and pop culture in general, getting its best goosing yet.

programme.title: Scary Movie 4
programme.desc: The all-star cast returns to pull serious spoofs of The Grudge, Saw, War of the Worlds, and The Village. While her house is haunted by a little boy, Cindy is determined to find out who killed him and why.

programme.title: Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Max and Page are a mother/daughter con team. Max targets wealthy men and marries them. Page then seduces them while Max "catches" her wayward husbands in the act. Then on to the next mark, posing in a variety of guises to keep one step ahead of the law.

programme.title: Runaway Bride
programme.desc: Julia Roberts plays a small-town girl whose marches down the aisle become a series of near Mrs. when she bolts before saying "I do."

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: A US West Coast teen lifestyle parody centered around Cher, a popular high school girl who spends her days playing match-maker, helping her friends with fashion choices, and looking for a boyfriend.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.

programme.title: The Silence of the Lambs
programme.desc: An FBI trainee is assigned by her superior to interview an imprisoned, cannibalistic psychopath, Hannibal the Cannibal Lecter, in the hope that he may help uncover the identity of an elusive serial killer.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: Widow and mother of three, Annie Wilson makes her living by foretelling others' futures...though her own has become cloudier than even she can see.

programme.title: Little Man Tate
programme.desc: A single, working-class mother can't give her musically, scientifically and emotionally gifted 7-year-old son the support and stimulation he needs--and neither can the director of a school for exceptional children, who takes him under her wing.

programme.title: Varsity Blues
programme.desc: At first, backup quarterback Jonathan is no football star. But when the starting quarterback is injured, he is thrown into the game and also finds himself in direct conflict with his coach and girlfriend.

programme.title: Indecent Proposal
programme.desc: Demi Moore and Woody Harrelson are Diana and David Murphy, a financially strapped couple who are betting on a quick trip to Las Vegas to deal them a lucky hand. But the odds are suddenly even more attractive when billionaire John Gage ups the ante.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Texas is at the mercy of murderous bandits. A group of unlikely heroes emerges to battle these renegade outlaws. Out-manned, they summon the courage to protect the innocent and put the wrong things right in their beloved homeland.

programme.title: Outlaw Posse
programme.desc: In 1908, Chief (Mario Van Peebles) returns from years of hiding to claim stolen gold. In his quest, he reunites an ensemble of familiar faces. Together, they fight off Angel, whose desire for the gold leaves a trail of dead bodies.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Join The Addams Family for the most hilarious scarefest of this season or any other! When long-lost Uncle Fester reappears after twenty-five years in the Bermuda Triangle, Gomez and Morticia plan a celebration to wake the dead.

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: The family’s future grows bleak when the no-good nanny marries Fester and has the kids shipped off to summer camp. But Wednesday still has a Thing or two up her sleeve.

programme.title: The Brothers Grimm
programme.desc: In this visionary film, Will and Jake Grimm dazzle small towns with their imaginative folklore and elaborate illusions, only to discover that many of the fantastic characters and thrilling situations from their beloved fairy tales are real.

programme.title: Semi-Pro
programme.desc: Will Ferrell and Woody Harrelson take on the world of pro basketball in this hilarious tale of the mythical Flint Michigan Tropics owner, coach, and star player, Jackie Moon, and his quest to take his team all the way to league champions!

programme.title: Here Comes the Boom
programme.desc: A biology teacher takes up fighting in mixed martial arts matches to raise money to save the school's music program.

programme.title: Caddyshack
programme.desc: It's the snobs against the slobs! While caddy Danny tries to impress elitist Judge Smails, a crude construction tycoon tries to get accepted at the country club, and a groundskeeper stalks a gopher.

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: When four teenagers all meet with mysterious deaths exactly one week after watching a videotape, investigative reporter Rachel Keller tracks down the video... and watches it.

programme.title: The Ring Two
programme.desc: When evidence at a local crime scene reveals a mysterious unmarked videotape, Rachel realizes that Samara is back and more determined than ever to continue her relentless cycle of terror.

programme.title: Hereditary
programme.desc: When the matriarch of the Graham family passes away, her daughter (Toni Collette) and grandchildren begin to unravel cryptic and increasingly terrifying secrets about their ancestry, trying to outrun the sinister fate they have inherited.

programme.title: The Dead Zone
programme.desc: A man awakens from a coma to discover he has a psychic detective ability.

programme.title: Cujo
programme.desc: While Donna and Vic Trenton struggle to save their rocky marriage, their son Tad befriends the loveable 200-lb St. Bernard who belongs to their mechanic.

programme.title: Pet Sematary (1989)
programme.desc: For most families, moving is a new beginning. But for the Creeds, it could be the beginning of the end because they've just moved in next door to a place that children built with broken dreams, the Pet Sematary.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom brings you thrills and excitement. Indy, his sidekick Short Round, and nightclub singer Willie Scott go from high-flying action above the Himalayas to a spine-tingling escape from a fortress-like mine in India.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: There's nothing more exciting than trying to keep up with the Joneses in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. Indy's Nazi enemies are back and have kidnapped his father in their effort to locate the sacred Holy Grail.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: STEVEN SPIELBERG and GEORGE LUCAS present Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull. Join Indy as he races against a brilliant and beautiful agent for the mystical, all-powerful crystal skull of Akator in this thrilling adventure!

programme.title: Frank Miller's Sin City
programme.desc: In these intertwined tales, a universe of unlikely and reluctant heroes try to do the right thing in a city that refuses to care.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

programme.title: The Whole Nine Yards
programme.desc: An unhappy dentist in Montreal gets a new neighbor, Jimmy 'The Tulip' Teduski, a former mob hitman turned informant with a price on his head.

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Enter the world of 1970s TV news, where Ron Burgundy and his loyal Channel 4 News Team are San Diego's #1 rated news source. All is well in their male-dominated world of news until rising star reporter Veronica Corningstone turns it upside down.

programme.title: Blades of Glory
programme.desc: Two figure skating rivals are banned from the sport after a brawl over the gold medal. Joining forces, they find a loophole in the rules that allows them to skate again... as a pair!

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father, Dusty (Wahlberg), shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.

programme.title: The Crow
programme.desc: Visually stunning and action-packed, this hit movie, based on the comic book series, follows the return from the grave of a young rock guitarist who, along with his fiancée, is brutally killed by a ruthless gang of criminals.

programme.title: The Faculty
programme.desc: A group of small-town high school students discovers their teachers are under the control of mind-controlling alien parasites. From a smart script by Kevin Williamson (SCREAM), and directed by action-expert Robert Rodriguez (FROM DUSK TO DAWN).

programme.title: Sleepy Hollow
programme.desc: Johnny Depp is Ichabod Crane, an investigator determined to stop the murderous Headless Horseman.

programme.title: Idle Hands
programme.desc: The devil will find work for idle hands to do, but what happens when he chooses the laziest teen slacker in the world to do his dirty work? Anton Tobias is a couch potato burnout who can't control the murderous impulses of his possessed hand. Rated: R

programme.title: Brian's Song
programme.desc: Based on the real-life relationship between teammates Brian Piccolo and Gale Sayers, the bond is established when Piccolo discovers that he is dying.

programme.title: Le Mans
programme.desc: Steve McQueen is an American endurance driver racing the 24 HOURS OF LE MANS in this fast and furious original movie. Filmed on location throughout the Le Mans circuit, with jaw dropping car crash stunts and heart-pounding action.

programme.title: The Longest Yard (1974)
programme.desc: In this rough-and tumble movie, actually filmed on-location at the Georgia State Prison, the cons are the heroes and the guards are the heavies.

programme.title: Universal Soldier
programme.desc: A woman reporter discovers a Defense Department project to create androids from the bodies of Vietnamese soldiers, to be then used as an elite anti-terrorism unit.

programme.title: World War Z
programme.desc: World War Z is the fast-paced, pulse-pounding epic of the potential last days of the human race. Former United Nations employee Gerry Lane (Brad Pitt) is called in to help stop the pandemic from spreading worldwide.

programme.title: Overlord
programme.desc: Nothing can prepare you for the mind-blowing mayhem that is Overlord. Mega producer J.J. Abrams creates an insanely twisted thrill ride about a team of American troops who come face-to-face with Nazi super-soldiers unlike the world has ever seen.

programme.title: Heist
programme.desc: A jewel thief's nephew is sent along on a heist to ensure a longtime partner in crime stays honest about the division of the loot.

programme.title: We Were Soldiers
programme.desc: In 1965, America is at war with North Vietnam, and Lt. Col. Hal Moore prepares his troops for one of the most violent battles in U.S. History: “The Valley of Death.”

programme.title: No Country For Old Men
programme.desc: Winner of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture, filmmakers Joel and Ethan Coen (FARGO) bring to the screen a thrilling bestseller in which a crime-scene's irresistible stolen loot sets forth an unstoppable chain reaction of violence.

programme.title: Power Rangers
programme.desc: A group of high-school students, who are infused with unique superpowers, harness their abilities in order to save the world.

programme.title: You Can't Run Forever
programme.desc: Suffering from acute anxiety, young Miranda faces a new terror when a serial killer chooses her as his next target. As he chases her through the woods, she soon finds the strength she never knew she had to elude her murderous tracker.

programme.title: Escape the Field
programme.desc: Stripped of their possessions, six strangers wake up in a remote, endless cornfield with six items. They soon realize they're in a mysterious cat-and-mouse game with an unseen evil, and survival depends upon solving a diabolical and deadly puzzle.

programme.title: The Golden Child
programme.desc: As ‘The Chosen One’, Murphy’s on a madcap mission to save The Golden Child, a youth with mystical powers who’s been abducted by an evil cult.

programme.title: 48 Hrs.
programme.desc: Nolte is a rough-edged cop after two vicious cop-killers. He can't do it without the help of smooth Murphy, who is serving time for a half-million-dollar robbery.

programme.title: Another 48 Hrs.
programme.desc: Times may change…but these guys don’t! Eddie Murphy and Nick Nolte are back on the streets in this smash sequel.

programme.title: The Inspection
programme.desc: Rejected by his mother and with few options, a young, gay Black man joins the Marines, doing whatever it takes to succeed in a system that would cast him aside, unexpectedly finding camaraderie, strength, and support in this new community.

programme.title: Love Jones
programme.desc: In this sweet, comic romance set against the jazz rhythms of Chicago, two educated, upscale urban artists discover modern courtship as they both experience a Love Jones.

programme.title: Down in the Delta
programme.desc: In Maya Angelou's directorial debut, a troubled single mother spends the summer at her family's ancestral home in rural Mississippi and learns to reverse the downward slide of her life in this uplifting story of family, community and friendship.

programme.title: The Terminator
programme.desc: A cyborg is sent from the future to assassinate a young woman who's destined to give birth to a son who will become the key to saving humanity.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: The non-human machine ruling elite of the nuclear war-torn future has dispatched a cyborg assassin into the past to kill a young boy because he soon will be the resistance leader against the machines.

programme.title: Terminator Genisys
programme.desc: When John Connor sends Kyle Reese back to 1984 to protect a young Sarah Connor, unexpected events alter the past and threaten the future for all mankind. Charged with a new mission, Reese must join forces with Sarah and her "Guardian" to save the world.

programme.title: Rocky
programme.desc: As the boxer 'everyman' Rocky Balboa, Sylvester Stallone comes out swinging with heart, humor, and unforgettable power as he 'goes the distance' against World Heavyweight Champion Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers) in this unforgettable, Oscar®- winning film!

programme.title: Rocky II
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone, Carl Weathers, and Burgess Meredith return for the rematch of the century as Rocky takes on Apollo Creed, even though his doctors advise against it, in this blockbuster sequel that brought audiences to their feet!

programme.title: Rocky III
programme.desc: Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) battles his most powerful adversary yet, Clubber Lang (Mr. T), in this hard-hitting actioner that comes out swinging as Rocky strives to regain the 'eye of the tiger' after a humiliating defeat in the ring.

programme.title: Baggage Claim
programme.desc: Montana Moore is determined to get engaged before her sister’s wedding in just 30 days!

programme.title: What Men Want
programme.desc: A successful sports agent (Taraji P. Henson) mysteriously gains the ability to hear men's thoughts. With this newfound power, she looks to outsmart her colleagues but the lengths she goes to put her relationships to the test in this hilarious comedy!

programme.title: Nobody's Fool (2018)
programme.desc: Tiffany Haddish is hysterical in Tyler Perry's most outrageous comedy yet. Wild child Tanya looks to her buttoned-up sister Danica to get back on her feet. As these opposites collide, Tanya learns that Danica's perfect life may not be what it seems.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America, along with the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and New York during the 1910s, then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: The Fluffy Movie
programme.desc: Stand-up comedian Gabriel Iglesias offers hilarious observations and impressions in this concert film featuring never-before-seen footage from his Unity Through Laughter tour. Directed by Manny Rodriguez.

programme.title: Spy Kids
programme.desc: Super-spies Gregorio (Antonio Banderas) and Ingrid (Carla Gugino) give up their lives of intrigue to raise their children. After a sinister super-villain kidnaps the parents, it's up to the kids to come to the rescue.

programme.title: Spy Kids 2: The Island of Lost Dreams
programme.desc: In the sequel, the OSS now has a full child-spy section and our hero siblings Carmen and Juni Cortez have become agents. On a mission to recover a dangerous device that threatens the entire world, they enlist the skills of their family.

programme.title: Silk Road (2021)
programme.desc: Ross launches the website Silk Road, an anonymous drug market, catching the focus of DEA agent Rick. As their private lives erode, they are trapped in a game of cat-and-mouse.

programme.title: Strangers (2024)
programme.desc: A frustrated woman encounters a mysterious hitman. Their romance leads to vigilante killings of criminals. As she delves deeper, she questions her partner's true nature and their hidden motives.

programme.title: Mean Girls (2024)
programme.desc: Cady Heron is a hit with the Plastics, an A-list girl clique at her new school, when she makes the mistake of falling for Aaron Samuels, the ex-boyfriend of alpha Plastic Regina George.

programme.title: MST3K: The Painted Hills

programme.title: The Italian Job
programme.desc: Charlie is out of jail and on the make with a plan for the heist of the century. Aided by top criminal mastermind Mr Bridger, Charlie sets off with a team of villains and to lift $4,000,000 from under the noses of the Turin Polizei.

programme.title: The Hound Of The Baskervilles (1959)
programme.desc: A hellish hound feeds upon the flesh of the heirs of Baskerville Hall. But before this beast can sink its teeth into the newest lord, it must pit its vicious fangs against the searing intellect of Sherlock Holmes (Peter Cushing) and Dr. Watson.

programme.title: Roman Holiday
programme.desc: Audrey Hepburn's portrayal of a modern-day princess, rebelling against the royal obligations, who explores Rome on her own. This romantic comedy ranks as one of the most enjoyable films of all times.

programme.title: 13 Hours: The Secret Soldiers of Benghazi
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay, 13 HOURS is the gripping true story of six elite ex-military operators assigned to protect the CIA who fought back against overwhelming odds when terrorists attacked a U.S. diplomatic compound on September 11, 2012.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back and gain the freedom of his people in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: Shooter
programme.desc: Determined to prove his innocence in a double-cross, Bob Lee Swagger is now in a high-tension race from every law enforcement agency in the US and a shadowy organization that wants him dead.

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part - IV: The Final Chapter
programme.desc: After his revival in a hospital morgue, the hockey-masked murderer fixes his vengeful attention on the Jarvis family and a group of hitherto carefree teenagers.

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part V: A New Beginning
programme.desc: This time, he seems to have set his sights on the young patients at a secluded halfway house. And more than a few of his teen targets end up in half, in quarters... You name it, Jason does it.

programme.title: Friday the 13th, Part VI: Jason Lives
programme.desc: As a child, Tommy Jarvis did what many others died trying to do. He killed Jason Vorhees, the mass murderer who terrorized the residents of Crystal Lake. But now, years later, Tommy is tormented by the fear that maybe Jason isn’t really dead.

programme.title: Head of State
programme.desc: When Washington desperately needs a presidential candidate just weeks before the election, they need someone sure to lose. They pick Mays Gilliam (Chris Rock), an unknown local politician from a down-and-out D.C. neighborhood, to be their puppet.

programme.title: Good Burger
programme.desc: Kenan & Kel are serving up laughs! They're the good guys in Good Burger, a zany comedy inspired by the popular Kel routine from Nickelodeon's hit series All That.

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: With showstopping performances by a star-studded cast, Dreamgirls soars with the amazing story of three female singers who learn that anything is possible when you hold on to your dreams.

programme.title: Albany Road
programme.desc: On her way to the most important meeting of her career, a New York executive is forced to share a rental car with her ex-fiancé's mother, only to discover that the mother is hiding a major secret.

programme.title: The Legend 2 [English Subtitled]
programme.desc: The Cantonese hero Fong Sai Yuk becomes involved in the secret brotherhood "The Red Flower", who are trying to overthrow the Manchurian emperor and re-establishing the Ming dynasty.

programme.title: Tai Chi Master [English Subtitled]
programme.desc: Two friends, ex Shaolin monks, part ways as they brush with the ongoing rebellion against the government. The ambitious one rises up to be a powerful military commander, while his betrayed friend resorts to learn the calm ways of Tai Chi.

programme.title: Legend of the Red Dragon
programme.desc: A young father and his infant son are beset by forces of evil and corruption. They wander China, upholding their sense of honor and protecting the weak. When they are forced into combat, spectacular and hilarious fast-motion kung fu sequences follow.

programme.title: Scary Movie 4
programme.desc: The all-star cast returns to pull serious spoofs of The Grudge, Saw, War of the Worlds, and The Village. While her house is haunted by a little boy, Cindy is determined to find out who killed him and why.

programme.title: Scary Movie 5
programme.desc: Home with their newly-formed family, happy parents Dan and Jody are haunted by sinister, paranormal activities — disrupting new mama Jody’s dancing aspirations in the “Swan Lake” ballet and threatening Dan’s rise as an ape researcher.

programme.title: The Dictator
programme.desc: Featuring never-before-seen footage that's outrageously funny! The creators and star of Borat bring you the hilarious comedy about what happens when the world's worst dictator is stuck in New York.

programme.title: Runaway Bride
programme.desc: Julia Roberts plays a small-town girl whose marches down the aisle become a series of near Mrs. when she bolts before saying "I do."

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: A US West Coast teen lifestyle parody centered around Cher, a popular high school girl who spends her days playing match-maker, helping her friends with fashion choices, and looking for a boyfriend.

programme.title: 10 Things I Hate About You
programme.desc: Cameron instantly falls for the girl of his dreams.

programme.title: John Tucker Must Die
programme.desc: Cheerleaders use a newcomer to exact revenge on their cheating boyfriend.

programme.title: The Silence of the Lambs
programme.desc: An FBI trainee is assigned by her superior to interview an imprisoned, cannibalistic psychopath, Hannibal the Cannibal Lecter, in the hope that he may help uncover the identity of an elusive serial killer.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: Widow and mother of three, Annie Wilson makes her living by foretelling others' futures...though her own has become cloudier than even she can see.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.

programme.title: The Pelican Brief
programme.desc: Academy Award winners Julia Roberts and Denzel Washington star in this thriller about a young law student whose theory about the recent deaths of two Supreme Court justices embroils her in a web of greed, corruption, and murder.

programme.title: Indecent Proposal
programme.desc: Demi Moore and Woody Harrelson are Diana and David Murphy, a financially strapped couple who are betting on a quick trip to Las Vegas to deal them a lucky hand. But the odds are suddenly even more attractive when billionaire John Gage ups the ante.

programme.title: The Truman Show
programme.desc: Truman doesn’t realize that his quaint hometown is a giant studio set run by a visionary producer/director/creator (Ed Harris), that folks living and working there are Hollywood actors, and that even his incessantly bubbly wife is a contract player.

programme.title: Fat Man and Little Boy
programme.desc: In the remote desert of New Mexico, “The Manhattan Project” is materializing – the World War II effort to build the atomic bomb.

programme.title: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Texas is at the mercy of murderous bandits. A group of unlikely heroes emerges to battle these renegade outlaws. Out-manned, they summon the courage to protect the innocent and put the wrong things right in their beloved homeland.

programme.title: Outlaw Posse
programme.desc: In 1908, Chief (Mario Van Peebles) returns from years of hiding to claim stolen gold. In his quest, he reunites an ensemble of familiar faces. Together, they fight off Angel, whose desire for the gold leaves a trail of dead bodies.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf, Tom Hardy, and Jessica Chastain star in this adaptation of 'The Wettest County in the World.' A bootlegging gang make a run for the American Dream during Prohibition.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: The Brothers Grimm
programme.desc: In this visionary film, Will and Jake Grimm dazzle small towns with their imaginative folklore and elaborate illusions, only to discover that many of the fantastic characters and thrilling situations from their beloved fairy tales are real.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: Here Comes the Boom
programme.desc: A biology teacher takes up fighting in mixed martial arts matches to raise money to save the school's music program.

programme.title: Caddyshack
programme.desc: It's the snobs against the slobs! While caddy Danny tries to impress elitist Judge Smails, a crude construction tycoon tries to get accepted at the country club, and a groundskeeper stalks a gopher.

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: Dodgeball is back, and this time it’s not just for the schoolyard.

programme.title: Semi-Pro
programme.desc: Will Ferrell and Woody Harrelson take on the world of pro basketball in this hilarious tale of the mythical Flint Michigan Tropics owner, coach, and star player, Jackie Moon, and his quest to take his team all the way to league champions!

programme.title: Hereditary
programme.desc: When the matriarch of the Graham family passes away, her daughter (Toni Collette) and grandchildren begin to unravel cryptic and increasingly terrifying secrets about their ancestry, trying to outrun the sinister fate they have inherited.

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: When four teenagers all meet with mysterious deaths exactly one week after watching a videotape, investigative reporter Rachel Keller tracks down the video... and watches it.

programme.title: The Ring Two
programme.desc: When evidence at a local crime scene reveals a mysterious unmarked videotape, Rachel realizes that Samara is back and more determined than ever to continue her relentless cycle of terror.

programme.title: Pet Sematary (1989)
programme.desc: For most families, moving is a new beginning. But for the Creeds, it could be the beginning of the end because they've just moved in next door to a place that children built with broken dreams, the Pet Sematary.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

programme.title: American Gigolo (1980)
programme.desc: Julian Kay has it all: the Mercedes, the clothes, access to Beverly Hills' swankiest establishments, and a stable of rich, female clients. But it all falls apart after he does a favor for his former pimp and the trick turns up dead a short while later.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: STEVEN SPIELBERG and GEORGE LUCAS present Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull. Join Indy as he races against a brilliant and beautiful agent for the mystical, all-powerful crystal skull of Akator in this thrilling adventure!

programme.title: Eagle Eye
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf and Michelle Monaghan star as two strangers trying to escape danger when they are ripped from their ordinary lives and 'activated' as part of a hightech assassination plot.

programme.title: Arrival
programme.desc: When mysterious spacecraft touch down across the globe, an elite team - led by expert translator Louise Banks (Academy Award® nominee Amy Adams) – races against time to decipher their intent.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

programme.title: The Whole Nine Yards
programme.desc: An unhappy dentist in Montreal gets a new neighbor, Jimmy 'The Tulip' Teduski, a former mob hitman turned informant with a price on his head.

programme.title: The Big Lebowski
programme.desc: Jeff Bridges, John Goodman, Steve Buscemi and Julianne Moore star in this Coen brothers’ cult comedy about the Dude, his buddies, a case of mistaken identity, kidnapping and bowling.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father, Dusty (Wahlberg), shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.

programme.title: Zoolander
programme.desc: Three-time male model of the year, Derek Zoolander, is devastated when he loses the title to newbie Hansel. After the news, Mugatu's fashion empire brainwashes Derek into being an assassin.

programme.title: School of Rock
programme.desc: Jack Black stars as a guitarist with delusions of grandeur. Kicked out of his band and looking for work, he becomes a substitute teacher and turns his class into rock and rollers.

programme.title: Sleepy Hollow
programme.desc: Johnny Depp is Ichabod Crane, an investigator determined to stop the murderous Headless Horseman.

programme.title: Idle Hands
programme.desc: The devil will find work for idle hands to do, but what happens when he chooses the laziest teen slacker in the world to do his dirty work? Anton Tobias is a couch potato burnout who can't control the murderous impulses of his possessed hand. Rated: R

programme.title: Romy and Michele's High School Reunion
programme.desc: Two friends try to reinvent themselves to impress old classmates.

programme.title: The Longest Yard (1974)
programme.desc: In this rough-and tumble movie, actually filmed on-location at the Georgia State Prison, the cons are the heroes and the guards are the heavies.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Hair

programme.title: Coach Carter

programme.title: Albany Road

programme.title: Fist Of Legend [English Subtitled]

programme.title: Meltdown

programme.title: Hitman [English-Language Version]
programme.desc: Two hitmen, one a novice and the other a veteran with poor luck, band together to find the "King of Killers" for whom there is a large reward.

programme.title: Scary Movie
programme.desc: The spoof that started it all. Scream with the Wayans brothers, Carmen Electra, Shannon Elizabeth, and Anna Faris as they bumble and shriek their way to horror-movie hilarity in Scary Movie.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Four teens are tricked by their professor into visiting a haunted house for a school project.

programme.title: Scary Movie 3
programme.desc: David Zucker (AIRPLANE!) directs SCARY MOVIE 3, which piles on hysterical yet gratuitous cameos from thrillers, blockbusters, and pop culture in general, getting its best goosing yet.

programme.title: 40 Dates and 40 Nights
programme.desc: Burned out on dating and ready to quit, Leah takes her eccentric grandma's outrageous challenge—40 dates in 40 nights for a full year of paid rent.

programme.title: Baggage Claim
programme.desc: Montana Moore is determined to get engaged before her sister’s wedding in just 30 days!

programme.title: What's Love Got to Do With It?
programme.desc: In London, an award-winning filmmaker documents her best friend's journey into an arranged marriage in line with his family's Pakistani heritage. In the process, she challenges her own attitude towards relationships.

programme.title: The Pelican Brief
programme.desc: Academy Award winners Julia Roberts and Denzel Washington star in this thriller about a young law student whose theory about the recent deaths of two Supreme Court justices embroils her in a web of greed, corruption, and murder.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: Widow and mother of three, Annie Wilson makes her living by foretelling others' futures...though her own has become cloudier than even she can see.

programme.title: Blue Velvet
programme.desc: A sensual mystery thriller about strange happenings in a small North Carolina town. A college student stumbles across a bizarre mystery and wants to know more, perhaps too much more.

programme.title: The Silence of the Lambs
programme.desc: An FBI trainee is assigned by her superior to interview an imprisoned, cannibalistic psychopath, Hannibal the Cannibal Lecter, in the hope that he may help uncover the identity of an elusive serial killer.

programme.title: Indecent Proposal
programme.desc: Demi Moore and Woody Harrelson are Diana and David Murphy, a financially strapped couple who are betting on a quick trip to Las Vegas to deal them a lucky hand. But the odds are suddenly even more attractive when billionaire John Gage ups the ante.

programme.title: Sense and Sensibility
programme.desc: Emma Thompson stars in the captivating romance based on Jane Austen's classic novel of two sisters' search for love in strict Victorian society.

programme.title: The English Patient
programme.desc: Unforgettable and powerful, this winner of 9 Academy Awards, including Best Picture, Best Director (Anthony Minghella) and Best Supporting Actress (Juliette Binoche) unfolds an incredible tale of passion, intrigue, and adventure.

programme.title: Outlaws and Angels
programme.desc: When Outlaws on the lam invade the home of an unsuspecting, seemingly innocent frontier family to hide out for the night, an unexpected game of cat and mouse ensues, leading to seduction, role reversal, and ultimately, bloody revenge.

programme.title: Bull
programme.desc: Kris is forced to help her neighbor, an ex-bull rider scraping by on the Texas rodeo circuit.

programme.title: Frank and Jesse
programme.desc: After the defeat of the South in the Civil War and the murder of their younger brother, Frank and Jesse James seek their own brand of justice. As outlaws, they gain fame for their daring hold-ups of banks, trains, and stagecoaches.

programme.title: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Air, Water, Earth, Fire. Four nations are tied by destiny when Fire launches war against the others. Caught between the war, one Avatar discovers he's able to manipulate all four elements.

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: On a mission to protect Earth, the battle-scarred and broken Bumblebee is found and repaired by a teenager named Charlie. They must work together to save the planet from the evil Decepticons in this action-packed adventure for the whole family.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Here Comes the Boom
programme.desc: A biology teacher takes up fighting in mixed martial arts matches to raise money to save the school's music program.

programme.title: Caddyshack
programme.desc: It's the snobs against the slobs! While caddy Danny tries to impress elitist Judge Smails, a crude construction tycoon tries to get accepted at the country club, and a groundskeeper stalks a gopher.

programme.title: Juwanna Mann
programme.desc: A basketball star is booted out of the NBA when his on-court antics go too far, so he poses as a woman and joins the WUBA. Rated PG-13

programme.title: Vacancy
programme.desc: A suspenseful, classic thriller, in the tradition of Alfred Hitchcock, starring Luke Wilson and Kate Beckinsale, that will keep you on the edge of your seat and your heart pounding! Rated: R

programme.title: It Follows
programme.desc: After a seemingly innocent sexual encounter, 19-year-old Jay becomes trapped by a vicious curse - "it" is following her, and the only way to save herself is to put others in harm's way.

programme.title: The Woman in Black
programme.desc: Author Kipps (Daniel Radcliffe), a widowed lawyer, is sent to a remote village to sort out the affairs of a recently deceased eccentric. But upon his arrival, it soon becomes clear that everyone in the town is keeping a deadly secret.

programme.title: Hamburger Hill
programme.desc: On the 11th May 1969, troops of the 101st Airborne Division engaged the enemy at the base of Hill 937 in the Ashau Valley. Ten days and eleven bloody assaults later, the troops who fought there called it Hamburger Hill.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

programme.title: The Accused (1988)
programme.desc: Jodie Foster gives an Oscar-winning performance as the hard, independent Sarah Tobias, who is assaulted in the back of a neighborhood bar. But that is only the beginning of her ordeal.

programme.title: Ghost In The Shell (2017)
programme.desc: Major (Scarlett Johansson) is the first of her kind, a human mind inside an artificial body. Discovering her creators lied about her past life to control her, Major will stop at nothing to unravel the mystery of her true identity and exact revenge.

programme.title: The Island
programme.desc: A man goes on the run after he discovers that he is actually a "harvested being", and is being kept along with others in a utopian facility.

programme.title: Overdrive
programme.desc: Scott Eastwood stars in this action-adventure from the writers of 2 Fast 2 Furious and the director of Taken. When two legendary car thieves are caught stealing from a mafia boss, they are given a week to nab a vintage Ferrari, or risk losing everything.

programme.title: Drive
programme.desc: A Hollywood stunt performer (Ryan Gosling) who moonlights as a wheelman discovers that a contract has been put on him after a heist gone wrong.

programme.title: To Live And Die In L.A.
programme.desc: Federal agent Richard Chance has a score to settle, and he's through playing by the rules. He vows to take down a murderous counterfeiter by any means necessary. But as the stakes grow higher, will Chance's obsession ultimately destroy him?

programme.title: City of God
programme.desc: This critically acclaimed global hit film is a true story of crime and redemption set in one of the most notorious slums: Rio de Janeiro's "City of God."

programme.title: Walk Hard: The Dewey Cox Story
programme.desc: Dewey Cox had it all: the women (over 411), the friends (Elvis), and the rock 'n' roll lifestyle (every pill and powder). But most of all, he had the music that transformed a dimwitted country boy into the greatest American rock star who never lived.

programme.title: Wayne's World
programme.desc: When a sleazy TV exec offers Wayne and Garth a contract to tape their late-night cable-access show at his network, they discover the road to the big time is full of gnarly twists and turns.

programme.title: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure
programme.desc: Our non-heinous heroes Bill (Alex Winter) and Ted (Keanu Reeves) are in danger of flunking history! But when the righteous Rufus (George Carlin) arrives in a time-travelling phone booth, the dense dudes discover their destiny!

programme.title: Ghost World
programme.desc: The story of neo-cool Enid and Rebecca who, faced with graduation from high school take a hard look at the world they wryly observe. When Rebecca focuses her attention on mutual romantic fixation Josh, the girls friendship is forever changed.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: A US West Coast teen lifestyle parody centered around Cher, a popular high school girl who spends her days playing match-maker, helping her friends with fashion choices, and looking for a boyfriend.

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Reese Witherspoon plays Tracy Flick, a straight-A go-getter determined to be president of Carver High’s student body. Popular teacher Jim McAllister (Broderick) decides to derail Tracy’s obsessive overachieving by recruiting an opposition candidate.

programme.title: Rockers
programme.desc: Night Flight Presents: Starring Leroy 'Horsemouth' Wallace and Richard 'Dirty Harry' Hall; ROCKERS is a story of oppressed Jamaican musicians getting even with the 'mafia types' in the business

programme.title: Foul Play
programme.desc: Beware of the Dwarf, whispers the hitchhiker to the beautiful librarian as he dies through a screening of This Gun Is Mine. Suddenly, Hawn is propelled into a world of wild chases and deadly encounters with an assortment of weird characters.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: World War Z
